environment: fresh empty working directory; every TAVONEL_* variable removed; no API key

steps.command: test "$(grep -i '^content-digest' headers.txt | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2)" = "sha-256=:$(openssl dgst -sha256 -binary sample-world.json | base64 -w0):" && echo "match: Content-Digest = sha-256 of the bytes received"
steps.stdout: match: Content-Digest = sha-256 of the bytes received

steps.command: test "sha256:$(sha256sum tavonel-public-sample.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(node -p "require('./channel.json').assets.recipePublicSample.sha256")" && echo "match: tavonel-public-sample.py = channel.json assets.recipePublicSample.sha256"

steps.stdout:

steps.command: test "sha256:$(sha256sum tavonel-cli.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(node -p "require('./channel.json').assets.cli.sha256")" && echo "match: tavonel-cli.mjs = channel.json assets.cli.sha256"
